plugins.Author: erdelf, Herculezz
plugins.Name: AutoDuty
plugins.Punchline: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
plugins.Description: A plugin to run dungeons for you with Trust, Duty Support, Squadrons, Variants, and Regular, Requires BossMod, vnavmesh and a Rotation Plugin (BossMod AutoRotation, Wrath or RotationSolverReborn)
plugins.Changelog:
## What's Changed
* Restricting Maintab role block to Looping by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/595
* Termination Options per Playlist Entry by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/596
  - very much a testing thing. Details might change in the future. Only the actual stop conditions are applied.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/compare/0.0.0.381...0.0.0.382
